goal: Deliver a runnable, documented multi-rail agent-payment adapter (one PaymentRail interface; EVM/USDC and Nano/XNO rails) that a wallet-SDK maintainer can check and cite as a working example.

laws.statement: NanoRail and UsdcRail both implement the same PaymentRail interface.
laws.test: Both concrete rails subclass PaymentRail and expose pay, quote, name.
laws.oracle: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); from agent_wallet_multirail.rails import PaymentRail, NanoRail, UsdcRail; assert issubclass(NanoRail, PaymentRail) and issubclass(UsdcRail, PaymentRail); r=NanoRail(); assert callable(r.pay) and callable(r.quote) and isinstance(r.name,str); print('RAILS-OK')"

laws.statement: NanoRail is feeless and sub-second while UsdcRail charges a fee
laws.test: quote() returns fee 0 and fast finality for Nano, positive fee for USDC
laws.oracle: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); from agent_wallet_multirail.rails import NanoRail, UsdcRail; n=NanoRail().quote(1.0); u=UsdcRail().quote(1.0); assert n.fee_usd==0 and n.finality_s<1; assert u.fee_usd>0; print('FEES-OK')"
